_provenance: Cycle 87. The lines of an Add Library refusal (`POST /library/sections`, a 400 with one CRLF line per failing check) that a real PMS translates, per request language: read off plexscratch42 (1.42.2) with each of the 44 X-Plex-Language values Plex Web sends and with `hu-HU`, over six refusing forms that between them raise all eleven lines. Only these three of the eleven are in the server's gettext catalogue; the other eight stay English in every language. The language is chosen as for an activity string (a regional catalogue first: `hu-HU` reads `hu_HU`, whose quoting differs from `hu`'s), and a language not listed keeps the English line, as `zh-TW`, `en-GB` and `my` do on the reference.
